---
title: "Awards Patterns"
description: "Experiments on Oscar history for movie fans."
---

Oscar arguments are more fun with numbers, so this site takes the ones fans keep having and checks them against the record.

## Experiments

### [Does the most-nominated film win Best Picture?](experiments/most-nominated.qmd)

It used to be a good bet. From 1981 to 2009, the film with the most nominations won 16 times out of 23, not counting ties. Since 2010, it has won 4 out of 13.
